name: Kandata Monogatari
source:
Champani tower stands in the sea of grass. Leader of thieves Kandata govers this place, and the policy is to steal, but not kill. A group of adventurers is sent to the tower to recover recently stolen goods. But thieves rub aphrodisiac in bugs' shells, so adventurers start to shake their hips violently in search for satisfaction.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
